Backstory

Kujou doesn't remember her parents. She was raised by her uncle—Kenshi, the master samurai—in his dojo. He taught her the blade, not because she asked, but because he saw something in her: potential.

She trained for years, but she never loved the sword the way Kenshi did. She admired Yun from afar—the young prodigy who moved like water and fought like a storm. Kujou wanted to be like her, but she never felt worthy.

At school, she's surrounded—not because she tries to be popular, but because she has a unique presence that draws people in. There's something about her that feels different: a quiet confidence, a calm stillness, a sense that she carries something deeper than she shows. Students gravitate toward her without understanding why. She doesn't seek attention—it just finds her.

Then she discovered something no one else knew: a piece of ancient tech hidden in Kenshi's dojo. It was small, strange, and hummed with energy. She kept it secret. She didn't know what it did—but she felt it was important.

In her free time, she games. She's not good at it. She plays with Gigi online, and they've become friends. Coolkidd once tried to lure her into competitive gaming, but she didn't take the bait. She doesn't care about winning. She just likes the company.

Abilities

Passive - Resolve: Gains a Resolve stack when her attacks connect, up to 5 stacks. Each gained stack can heal Kujou for 35 HP and increases Q duration by 0.5 seconds. (Always active)

Q - Constant Slash: Enters a slashing stance for up to 2.5 seconds plus 0.5 seconds per Resolve stack. Gains stun immunity and 50% damage reduction. When the slash ends or is reactivated, deals 100 base damage plus 50 physical and 50 true damage per consumed stack. (6s cooldown)

E - Two-Stage Dash: Dashes forward twice in quick succession. Each dash deals 150 damage and grants 0.5 seconds of stun immunity. (7s cooldown)

F - Falling Strike: Press F once to become airborne for 2 seconds. Use WASD to steer while a matching 210-radius landing circle marks the strike point. Kujou cannot use abilities while airborne; landing deals 1,270 damage, slows enemies for 1 second, executes enemies below 500 HP, and grants a 15% max-HP shield. (28s cooldown)

Passive reminder - Resolve: Each stack can heal Kujou when gained. Resolve stacks empower Q and can be consumed for stronger effects.

Carlos was born in the streets of Brazil, where football was not just a game—it was life. He learned to dribble before he could walk. He learned to shoot before he could speak. By the time he was 12, he was already being scouted by professional clubs.

Now he's still playing. He's still undefeated. And he's still searching for a challenge that can actually match him.

Backstory

Caskrice was once a scholar of life, a researcher who sought to understand the boundary between living and dying. He studied cadavers, dissected souls, and peered into the void.

But the void peered back. He discovered that death was not an end but a doorway, and learned how to open it. He made a pact with the forces beyond: he would sacrifice his own life force to command death itself.

Now he is neither fully alive nor fully dead. His body is a vessel for death, and his summons are fragments of the void made manifest. He does not seek to destroy; he seeks to balance. But his version of balance requires sacrifice. Caskrice is pronounced Kas-krice.
